thread:
emma: Proposal: pin SDK v2.7.x for llama3a-serving routes while we land runtime 4.0 to avoid client-RPC surface churn.

rao: Why pin at SDK vs runtime? SDK pin avoids forcing infra-wide runtime freezes but blocks new client features.

emma: tradeoff: minimize regressions for active customers. plan: SDK minor pin + runtime soft-pin limited to model-group "llama3a-prod" for 48h canary.

sdk-bot: [warning] SDK v2.8 will remove legacy RPC heartbeat. Clients using `session.keepalive` will break. Recommend a deprecation note.

pavel: ops note: soft-pin runtime 4.0 -> 3.9 shim causes kvcache mismatch for long-seq. Suggest prefill + small jitter on rollout to avoid thundering.

emma: suggested deploybot commands to schedule:
```
/deploy pin sdk v2.7 --target=routes:llama3a-prod --ttl=48h
/deploy soft-unpin runtime 4.0 --target=modelgroup:llama3a-prod --stages=10,30,100 --observe=10m
```

deploybot: [info] scheduled: sdk pin 1749999999 by @emma; soft-unpin runtime steps scheduled at 1750000200 -> 1750000400 -> 1750000500. To cancel: `/deploy cancel 1749999999`.

ops: cost ok for 48h monitoring. QA: add 40-seed gen-check at each stage; fail -> auto-revert.

rao: add a hook: if SDK telemetry shows >2% schema errors, block further rollout and notify SDK leads.

emma: agreed. Decision: proceed with SDK pin + limited runtime soft-unpin canary. Owners: @emma (release note), @pavel (prefill), @ops (cost), @rao (telemetry gate). Keep thread for post-mortem.
